isolation.setup: tests/integration/apply-migrations.ts applies TEST_MIGRATIONS inside the pool

covered: Published meal+cafe remain recommendable when parking data is unavailable; hidden and recommendation-excluded places are omitted.
Course-context-v2 selected safely when no verified hours exist; algorithm version and maximum2 badges are asserted.
D1 course context returns OPEN at verified Saturday KST hours and filters unsupported manual traits.
Parking returns PARKING_DATA_UNAVAILABLE without active snapshot; single active eligible facility returns READY with snapshot metadata; explicit separate-parking choice is respected.
Repository returns active B facility rather than retired snapshot; active EV linkage can set hasOnsiteEv true.
Operating-hours helper covers no-hours UNKNOWN, in-hours OPEN, after-hours CLOSED, previous-day overnight interval.
Parking-hours helper covers exit margin, crossing midnight, Saturday and holiday schedules.
Distance helper checks rounding/walking uplift, worst-leg burden ordering, and same-distance cohort true/false.
not_covered: No browser acceptance of course/parking result rendering, controls, errors, or feature-flag paths. No /courses or5199 requests were made.
No full DB-integrated CLOSED/UNKNOWN hours matrix, explicit isClosed=true holiday, or opening/closing exact-minute boundary.
READY ranking has one eligible facility, so multi-candidate distance ranking, far-away exclusion, and numerical returned travel/fee correctness are not proven.

Recommendation calls use EV NONE; strict/prefer EV outcomes are not exercised. Repository test has both active and retired EV links, so retired-only exclusion is not independently proven by that assertion.
NO_ELIGIBLE_PARKING, underlying DB/provider errors, kill-switch/recovery, backup/restore, live data quality/rights remain outside this run.
No runtime/dependency/flag/provider changes and no claim of full U08 or T08 completion.

covered: Pure ranking prefers nearby over distant public parking and balances both walking legs before same-cohort public/capacity tie breaks.
REQUIRED and PREFERRED choose an EV-equipped shared candidate; NONE chooses closer normal candidate in the same fixture.
Separate parking includes round-trip walking and7minute overhead; REQUIRED allows one EV-equipped stop.
Rain+child fixture chooses the nearer separate-parking candidate; close normalized mode scores return BOTH_SIMILAR.
Estimated fees preserve UNKNOWN asnull and FREE as0;31minutes rounds to1500 and180minutes caps at3000 under the supplied rule.
Static page source declares /courses, all8shareable filter fields, mobile initial dialog behavior, parking fallback and walking-distance labels, toggle controls and2-item limit.
limitations: Course-page-policy assertions read source strings only: they do not execute loader, prove browser accessibility, prove live feature-flag state, or interact with the UI.
EV shared test asserts the top candidate, not that every non-EV candidate is removed under REQUIRED; no-EV available outcome is not tested.
Ranking and fee proofs are pure functions with supplied synthetic candidates/rules, not multi-candidate D1-to-UI end-to-end behavior.
Provider-error/NO_ELIGIBLE_PARKING, live data, operational flags/gates and full U08/T08 completion remain unverified.
